"import cadquery as cq

L = 160.0
W = 100.0
T = 12.0
FILLET_R = 12.0
HOLE_D = 10.0
HOLE_X = 58.0
HOLE_Y = 28.0

part = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .rect(L, W)
        .extrude(T)
        .edges("|Z").fillet(FILLET_R)
        .faces(">Z").workplane()
        .pushPoints([(-HOLE_X, -HOLE_Y), (HOLE_X, -HOLE_Y),
                     (-HOLE_X, HOLE_Y), (HOLE_X, HOLE_Y)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0)
        .cutThruAll())

cq.exporters.export(part.val(), "part.step")"
